title: SK Telecom seeks returns from workplace AI push
caption:
South Korea's top mobile network encouraged thousands of staff to create their own AI agents. While the tools now decode complex legacy databases, proving real financial returns is a different challenge.

Source: Koreaherald - SK Telecom seeks returns from workplace AI push
